entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this VeloBand tracker. I've been trying for weeks and your entire system is a joke. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I do apologize for any frustration you've experienced. My ID is 302 if you need it. To start, can I get your full name and order number?
The name is Sarah Jenkins. The order is VF9-8675309. Don't tell me I'm outside the return window. I have proof I tried to do this earlier.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault with the band or is it a matter of preference?

It's a matter of your company being incompetent! I tried to return this on December 24th, which was day nine! I went to your site, and it was a complete mess—a massive website error page. The whole return system was down!
I see. I am checking our system logs for that date. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return?

I just told you! The system was down! It kept timing out. I couldn't print a label, I couldn't get a QR code, nothing. I even took a screenshot of the error page. This is ridiculous. Get me a manager. I'm a VIP member and I will plaster this all over social media.

There's no need for that, Sarah, I can absolutely handle this for you. And you are correct, I am seeing a note here about a known service outage on the 24th that affected our returns portal. I sincerely apologize that you were impacted by that; it's completely our fault.
So you're going to fix it? You're going to give me my refund?

Of course. Let me just confirm the policy. I see the delivery date was December 15th. Our return policy allows for a full refund within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. The website issue just adds to it. I am processing your return authorization right now.
Wait, 90 days? I thought the email for this new model said something about 10 days.

My apologies for any confusing communication you may have received. Our standard VeloFit policy is 90 days, and that's what I am authorized to use for your order. I've just sent the pre-paid return label to your email on file. And for the trouble our system down time caused you, especially as a VIP member, I've also added a 25% discount code to your account for your next purchase.
Oh. A full refund and a 25% discount? Okay. Well, that's... that's much better. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's already sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
